d: Sandpapergate was supposed to be done and dusted, a closed chapter for Australian cricket, but Usman Khawaja's new claims have dragged the 2018 ball-tampering scandal right back into the spotlight and got a pretty fiery response from captain Pat Cummins, and from Steve Smith and David Warner to Cameron Bancroft, the Cape Town controversy still has everyone asking who knew what and how much responsibility Australia's cricket establishment should actually shoulder, so Rupha Ramani looks at why the Sandpaper scandal refuses to disappear and what Cummins' strong response tells us about where…
